next.reason: 1985: 'When the ALL PROCEDURES phrase is specified, procedure-name-1 must not be specified in any USE FOR DEBUGGING statement.'; 2023: "No USE FOR DEBUGGING format among the 2023 USE statement rules; the Debug module's ALL PROCEDURES phrase is not carried.".
